entities.name: Foresters Life Insurance Company
entities.description: 'No medical, simplified issue life and critical illness insurance underwritten by The Independent Order of Foresters or Foresters Life Insurance Company.' The cpp.ca page does not itself state FLIC's parent (foresters.com's Legal page names FLIC as an IOF subsidiary).

operating_entities.note: cpp.ca has no legal-entities or leadership page (/legal returns 404; /about-us, /about-us-old, /legal-terms-and-conditions-life-insurance and /privacy-policy-life-insurance all carry the same footer). The footer is the operating-entities disclosure. Older marketing PDFs on cpp.ca add 'Used under license' and name FLIC as 'a subsidiary of The Independent Order of Foresters'. CPP Inc. holds no general account; invested assets sit with FLIC/IOF (see foresters_life.json).

ceo.name: Matt (Matthew M.) Berman

ceo.reports_to: IOF Board of Directors (Chair: Daniel J. Fortin)
ceo.prior: AXA (US), AIG, Zurich Insurance (P&C and life/savings; bio says 30 years in industry); at Foresters: President FLIAC, Chief Distribution Officer, President US (2019), President US & Canada (2023-03)
ceo.tenure_source: company bio (foresters.com executive-team page); press releases (PR Newswire 2023-03; Newswire.ca Jan 2024)

Berman, as President US & Canada (2023-03) and then CEO (2024-01), is the accountable executive for the CPP brand. industry_since left null: bio states '30 years of experience' but gives no start year. No LinkedIn snippet surfaced in search results.

cio.name: Alvin Sharma
cio.title: Global Chief Financial Officer (accountable executive for Investment and Asset Liability Management functions; no Chief Investment Officer title exists on the current leadership page)
cio.prior: CFO, Echelon Insurance (c. 2012-2018, ~6 years per Insurance Business); earlier life insurance and asset management roles in the US, UK and Canada; CA (UK), CFA
cio.tenure_source: company bio (executive-team page: appointed Sep 2018); press releases (Foresters newsroom Aug 2018; Investment Executive; Insurance Business Canada)
cio.comp_source: Not disclosed (fraternal; aggregate key-management pay only)
cio.note: CPP has no investment function; per the brief, the CIO section uses Foresters' investment leadership. Designated as the most senior investment officer because his company bio states he is 'responsible for the Global Financial, Investment, Actuarial, Asset Liability Management, Capital management and business planning functions'. AM Best's Oct 2025 officer list still shows 'Chief Investment Officer, Vice President: Clark D. Wagner (Investments)', but public career data (MarketScreener) end Wagner's CIO role on 2019-11-05 when the US asset manager was sold to Macquarie, and foresters.com lists no CIO; treat Wagner as stale. The general account is 100% externally managed (AM Best Oct 2025); an internal 'Investments team' oversees the external asset managers (OSFI Climate Risk Management Report 2025). industry_since null: start of career not given in any source.
